style: A still from an 80s dark fantasy film, painted like an epic fantasy matte painting. Cinematic low camera angle, dramatic rim light from behind, thick drifting fog and haze, deep black shadows, a muted teal grey palette with one glowing hot accent colour. Moody, epic and menacing, the whole creature in frame, facing left.
shark: A huge sand shark, a monster that swims through desert sand like water. Dusty red brown back, pale cream belly, a huge jaw full of jagged bone white teeth, a tall blade shaped dorsal fin, a ridge of spines down its back and a heavy powerful tail, each of them clearly visible. Old spear scars and broken spear shafts stuck in its hide.
shark_scene: Scene: the red sand wastes at dusk in a rising sandstorm, a huge low sun burning orange red through the haze behind it, two tiny hunters with spears in the foreground for scale.
bear: A huge cave bear, a living animal that has grown polished steel through its own body like extra bones, a cyborg beast. Warm brown shaggy fur. A polished steel ribcage bursts out through its chest like a cage, and inside the cage a glowing turquoise heart shows between the steel bars. A polished steel crest grows along the top of its skull and stops above its eyes, so its real bear face shows. Thin turquoise glowing seams where the steel meets the flesh. Organic and alive, not a robot.
bear_scene: Scene: a foggy mountain pass of grey stone and old steel ruins high in the snow, cold teal grey light, the turquoise glow of its heart lighting the fog around it, two tiny hunters with rifles in the foreground for scale.

ideas.shark-1: It leaps clear of the sand in a long arc with its jaws wide open and sand streaming off its body, sleek and fast, long thin quills down its back like a porcupine's.
ideas.shark-2: It bursts up out of a sand dune at a steep angle with its tail lashing behind it, its body thick and heavy and covered in rough armoured hide, short heavy bone plates down its back.
ideas.shark-3: It twists across the top of the sand in a tight curve like an eel, its long serpentine body coiled so its jaw, fin, spines and tail all show, a crest of long jagged bone blades down its back.
ideas.bear-1: One of its front legs is a giant bionic arm ending in a huge mechanical grappling claw. It stands on all fours, low and heavy, roaring with steel fangs, the claw arm reaching forward. Steel shows only in the ribcage, the claw arm and the skull crest.
ideas.bear-2: One of its front legs is a giant bionic arm ending in a huge mechanical grappling claw. It rears up on its hind legs to its full height, roaring with steel fangs, the claw arm raised high. Steel vertebrae run down its spine and steel shoulder bones break out through the fur.
ideas.bear-3: One of its front legs is a giant bionic arm ending in one huge two pronged mechanical pincer. It hunches forward with its shoulders high, roaring with steel fangs, the pincer arm dragging along the ground. Steel bones show through the fur along its back and legs, like a skeleton breaking through.
